subject: Request refund for September charge

Hi there,

I need to request a refund for our most recent invoice. We were charged $840 on September 20th (invoice INV-202609-18331) and I realized we should have downgraded to Team last month. Our project wrapped up in August and we're down to just 8 active users now, but I forgot to adjust the plan before the billing date. Grace Jensen

subject: Timeline view showing wrong dates
body:
I'm seeing a weird issue with the timeline view for our projects. Tasks that are due on a specific date are showing up one day earlier on the timeline. For example, a task due September 5th appears on September 4th in the view. I expected the timeline to display tasks on their actual due dates. This seems like it might be a timezone or UTC offset problem—our workspace is set to US/Pacific. It's been like this for at least a week now.

Here's an example task (PROD-284) that shows the offset:

```
Task: PROD-284
Due date (task detail): 2026-09-05
Displayed on timeline: 2026-09-04
Workspace timezone: America/Los_Angeles
Browser timezone: America/Los_Angeles
```

subject: Phishing email claiming to be from Quillstack billing
body:
Hi there,

I wanted to report a phishing attempt I received this morning. I got an email that appeared to come from Quillstack billing (though the actual sender address was noreply@quillstack-secure.net, which looked suspicious). The email claimed there was an urgent billing issue with our workspace and that I needed to "verify my account" by clicking a link and entering my Quillstack password.

I didn't click the link or provide any information, but I'm concerned because the email looked fairly convincing—it had your logo and similar formatting to legitimate invoices we've received. I wanted to make you aware of this so you can warn other customers.

I've forwarded the original email to security@quillstack.com as well. Is there anything else I should do on my end? Should I be concerned about our account security? I'm the only person with access currently since we're on the Free plan, and I haven't shared my password with anyone.

Thanks for looking into this.

Best,
Chidi Varga
Lumen Agency
